evidence_or_definition: SEEDLING contains species counts per microplot, not individually linked seedling records.
limitation_or_required_work: Cannot infer individual seedling survival, growth, or the fraction converting to saplings.

evidence_or_definition: TREE SPCD=318, STATUSCD=1, 1<=DIA<5, RECONCILECD=1, PREV_TRE_CN null, comparable sampled forest footprint.
limitation_or_required_work: New live sapling tally at follow-up is a condition-level establishment proxy; exact crossing date and intervening deaths are unobserved.

evidence_or_definition: RECONCILECD=1 also occurs on new >=5-inch trees sampled on larger subplots.
limitation_or_required_work: Do not interpret these as measured seedling-to-sapling transitions; they may have been untallied saplings outside the microplot. Code 2 through-growth needs separate review.
source: FIADB User Guide v9.4, RECONCILECD and national plot design

evidence_or_definition: Starting MANUAL=9.0, RECONCILECD 1-2 exclude procedure/definition changes and cruiser error; codes 7/8 handle those cases. Missed-live code 3 is retired from version 9.0.
limitation_or_required_work: Audit each historical manual period; a null PREV_TRE_CN alone never establishes biological recruitment.

evidence_or_definition: Join follow-up PREV_TRE_CN to baseline TREE.CN and expected successor PLOT.CN; retain STATUSCD and RECONCILECD.
limitation_or_required_work: Do not label STATUSCD=0, unlinked records, or species reidentifications as mortality; audit dead-sapling protocol changes before pooling historical fates.
source: FIADB TREE and PLOT schema; FIADB User Guide STATUSCD/RECONCILECD

evidence_or_definition: The audit recomputes follow-up sapling absence from TREE in conditions already verified sampled and comparable, and exports aggregate BALIVE/treatment/tally diagnostics.
limitation_or_required_work: Zero is defensible only on a verified sampled frame; do not globally fill absent measurements with zero.
source: Current cohort COND, PLOT, and TREE records

evidence_or_definition: Active group-800 codes used: 801, 802, 805, 809; both visits DESIGNCD=1, MANUAL>=1; current EVALID filter removed.
limitation_or_required_work: Not a validated pooled cohort: audit old forest-type codes, seedling protocols, sample-kind/duplicate records, condition transitions, interval outliers, and overlap before modeling.
source: Existing longitudinal extractor with only evaluation scope generalized

evidence_or_definition: Baseline requires maple >=5 inches and current active northern-hardwood forest type; follow-up requires sampled forest and stable microplot condition mapping.
limitation_or_required_work: Does not represent all Michigan forest or converted/nonsampled/strongly remapped conditions; examine excluded-condition bias and survey design.

evidence_or_definition: Which baseline conditions predict new sugar-maple sapling tally and retention or diameter growth of already established saplings?
limitation_or_required_work: Use separate stage-specific endpoints and clustered validation; declare a retrospective temporal check before model comparisons. This snapshot has already been explored, so it is not untouched validation. Compare against starting abundance and sampling effort.
source: Feasibility audit; proposed research direction, not fitted inference
